source: Natural Earth (public domain) — admin_0 110m, geography_regions 10m, admin_1 10m, admin_0 10m
orderNote: draw order, largest first — a contained region must be drawn after its container to stay hoverable
continentSource: Old World: WGSRPD level 1, folded to Africa / Asia / Oceania. Papuasia (New Guinea, PNG, Bismarck Archipelago, Solomon Islands, Maluku) is Asia-Tropical under WGSRPD and is therefore Asia here; Oceania = Australasia only. New World: colloquial, NOT WGSRPD — North America / Central America / Caribbean / South America, matching the site's habit of colloquial continent tags. Strict WGSRPD would file Costa Rica and Cuba under Southern America. Assignment is an explicit table in the builder; an unlisted place aborts the build.
frameNote: viewBox is fitted to the places the archive actually covers; places marked "frame": false in places.json are drawn but excluded from it. viewBoxAll is the extent of every shape in the file.
hdNote: HIGH-DETAIL build for the genus range map: tolerances at 0.25x the journal shapes.json, country geometry from admin_0 10m, plus a `borders` country-hairline path. The journal map must keep using shapes.json.
